description: 2.4 and 5 GHz Wi-Fi & RF spectrum analyser for ESP32-C5 over USB

store.summary: 2.4 & 5 GHz spectrum analyser for an ESP32-C5 plugged into the side USB port
store.description: Plug an ESP32-C5 board running esp32c5-spectrum (or ESP-SDR) into the CardputerZero's side USB port to view live 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz radio energy, scrolling waterfall history, spectral density, and Wi-Fi channel busy scorecards. Powered by ESP-SDR (Florian Euchner / ESPARGOS, GPL-3.0).
